exact_missing_items: The addenda in Wiring_Matrix.md increasingly ask the matrix to cover runtime producers, blocked/recovery actions, and projection consumers, but the actual schema still models only UI element rows
The prose is now expecting more than Wiring_Matrix.schema.json can encode
Decide whether the matrix remains strictly UI-element wiring plus a separate producer/consumer matrix, or whether the schema is intentionally widened to cover both
The matrix already uses JSON filenames (cmd.*.json) as fragment identifiers that could be extracted programmatically, but extraction is fragile without a schema commitment
add a schema-level filename-derivation rule that is explicit about the JSON filename for a command-family row so tooling can safely extract, validate, and round-trip between catalog and matrix
